name: Cleared 23 Choice
definition: Indicates whether the contract was cleared, not cleared or if the contract is intended to be cleared.

Cleared.name: Cleared
Cleared.definition: Indicates that the contract has been cleared.

IntendToClear.name: Intend To Clear
IntendToClear.definition: Indicates that the contract is intended to be cleared.

NonCleared.name: Non Cleared
NonCleared.definition: Indicates that the contract has not been cleared.
